rationale: The reduced high-signal module labels are selected by Mission 3AN from approved ASL Citizen lesson-manifest clips with nonzero signer-disjoint validation and test recall.

source_basis.purpose: Mission 3AN selected high-signal reduced module labels.

external_review.claim: No external Deaf educator, ASL instructor, or reviewer approval is claimed by this evidence.

limitations: This evidence selects source-curated labels for a local reduced-module learnability preflight only.
It does not promote a browser model, thresholds, final readiness, or redistributed ASL Citizen media.
